_doc: Story Mode chapters. Each chapter: cards shown before the fight, the fight itself (player/opponent/stage), and lines shown after a win. 'choose': true lets the player pick their champion.

intro.title: DC'S ARROWVERSE: FIGHT NIGHT
intro.subtitle: Prologue
lines: Central City. A rare night off. Team Flash, Team Arrow, Team Supergirl and the Legends gather at S.T.A.R. Labs for a crossover celebration.
Okay, I have officially rigged the speakers, the lights, AND the karaoke machine. Nothing can go wrong.
Cisco, you just said the words.
GREETINGS, HEROES! Welcome to the ULTIMATE CROSSOVER EVENT!
Who is that? And why is he on every screen?
I'm the showrunner now! You're all contestants. Fight each other... or stay trapped in my simulation forever. Places, everyone!
The room twists into static. When it clears, the heroes are scattered across worlds stitched together from their own memories.

chapters.title: The Rules of the Game
before: green_arrow
Barry. I don't like this any more than you do. But if fighting is the way out, we fight.
flash
Oliver, there has to be another way.
control_freak
There isn't! Speed versus tactics! ROLL CAMERA!
after: So did you. Something about this place feels wrong. Like it's reading us.

chapters.title: Quick and Clean
before: martian_manhunter
Kara. His remote reaches into my mind. I cannot hold back for long.
supergirl
Then I'll end this fast. Nobody gets hurt. Promise.
after: Thank you. His grip has loosened. This world is built from memories... stolen ones.

chapters.title: Push Back
before: wild_dog
Look, Canary, I don't hit teammates. But this freak says the Glades get erased if I don't fight.
black_canary
Then we fight. And then we find him and make him regret every rule he wrote.
after: Okay. Okay. You win. Now can we go break his stupid remote?
That's the first good idea anyone's had all night.

chapters.title: Glitches in the Arena
before: citizen_steel
Cisco! The Waverider's windows are showing three different centuries at once!
vibe
Temporal anomalies, repeating textures... Nate, this whole world is a recording!
control_freak
Shh! No spoilers! FIGHT!
after: Okay, I'm a historian. Repeating details mean someone copy-pasted. That's lazy writing.
Which means there's a seam. And seams can be breached.

chapters.title: Turned Against Us
before: flash
Nate... I can't stop running. He's scripting my legs!
citizen_steel
Then I'll be the wall you run into. Sorry in advance, Barry.
after: Thanks. My head's clear. He's adapting the arenas to us. Every fight he learns more.
Then we stop playing the game he expects.

chapters.title: Static on the Line
before: vibe
Oliver, my breaches keep opening on their own! I think he's using my powers as his doorway!
green_arrow
Then I close the door. Brace yourself.
after: Ow. But it worked. I can feel his signal now. He's broadcasting from somewhere... wrong.

chapters.title: Hope Under Pressure
before: supergirl
Laurel, run! He's pushing red sun radiation through the code. I can't control my strength!
black_canary
Not running. I'm loud enough to snap you out of it.
after: That... was a very effective wake-up call.
Told you. Now let's find this guy.

chapters.title: Break the Show
before: The heroes reach the edge of the simulation: Vandal Savage's ruined future, rebuilt from the Legends' nightmares.
wild_dog
J'onn... it's in my head. I see Zoe. He says if I lose, she's gone.
martian_manhunter
It is a lie, Rene. A script. Let me show you the difference between a man and a character.
after: And now neither is his control over us. The final door is ahead.

chapters.title: Earth-X
before: citizen_steel
Kara, he's thrown everything at us. He's going to make the last fight count.
supergirl
Then let's give him one last show... and stop following his script halfway through.
control_freak
Wait. What? That's not in the outline!
after: You... you broke the format! Nobody breaks the format!
We're not characters. We're people. And we're coming for you.

chapters.title: Season Finale
before: control_freak
FINE! If you won't play by my rules, I'll cancel you MYSELF! Season Finale, live, NOW!
Every hero lends their strength to one champion. The final battle begins.
after: No... no no no. My ratings... my beautiful show...
Everybody, hold on to each other. We're going home.
The world dissolves into light. The heroes wake in S.T.A.R. Labs, the party lights still blinking. Together. Real.
THE END. Control Freak is now playable, and Freak's Studio is unlocked for Versus.
